The workspace is a meta-repo whose only tracked code lives in two Git submodules — `src/backend` (InterSystems IRIS ObjectScript classes/routines for each product: doc-ws, cure-ws, dental-ws, epmi-mc, opadm-mc, pilot-project-ws, pilot-study-ws, public-mc, triage-ws, conting-ws) and `src/frontend` (CSP + jQuery/HISUI pages under the same product layout). All cross-cutting tooling is centralized in `scripts/`: Node.js CLI tools parse `.gitmodules` to discover submodules and operate uniformly on them (branch sync, stash, MR creation via GitLab REST API or push options, log aggregation), while `sftp-sync.js` maps local product paths to per-product SFTP channels defined in `.vscode/sftp.json` for uploading frontend assets to `<remote-path>`. Backend files are compiled directly into the IRIS server via MCP (`iris_doc_load`, `iris_doc_compile`) rather than SFTP. The root also hosts agent guidance (`.agents/`, AGENTS.md) and a prototype page, tying developer/AI workflows to the same submodule boundaries.
